page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmc8y.32xlarge is an arm64-based bare metal server instance powered by the custom Alibaba Yitian 710 processor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.75 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include any local NVMe SSD storage, requiring external block storage solutions. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to support high-throughput network operations. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The arm64 architecture of the YiTian710 processor offers high compute density and energy efficiency, making it a cost-effective alternative to traditional x86 architectures for highly parallel workloads. With its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this compute-optimized instance is suited for containerized microservices, web serving, distributed analytics, and high-concurrency CPU-bound applications that do not require local storage or GPU acceleration.
